t: Pack of 6 reusable magnetic radiator reflector sheets suitable for steel water filled, non-electrical radiators up to 1200 x 600mm. Heat reflector foil is designed to help reduce heat lost through walls, and to help lower carbon emissions. Quick and easy to install without removing the radiator. Foil can be cut to size with household scissors. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
b: Supplied in Kerbside Recyclable Card/Paper Packaging
